titulo: How Google decides to show your business
hooks: They Google you and you don't show up?
Google can't guess what you do
Search your trade and your neighborhood now
voz: When someone searches plumber in Austin, Google shows the websites that say clearly what they do and where. To show up, your website needs a title with your trade and your area, original copy and a Google Maps listing. With just Instagram, you barely make that list.
captions: Google shows whoever explains clearly what they do and where. If your website's title just says 'Welcome,' Google has no idea you're a plumber in Austin.
To start showing up: a title with your trade and your area, copy you wrote yourself, and a Google Maps listing with photos and hours.
Search your trade and your neighborhood on Google, the way a customer would. Do you show up? Do your competitors? There's your answer.
